ambient_events: Somewhere upstream a sluice gate shifts on its own and the water changes its mind.
A cold draught comes off the east tunnel, carrying rot and rust.
The channel gurgles as it swallows another slick of runoff from the streets above.
description: A junction of old sluice gates where the overflow chamber empties east into the deeper trunk lines. Rusted iron paddles hang half-raised on their chains, and the water runs faster here, funnelled and purposeful. The brick is older than the streets that stand on it.
name: Sluice Gate
